mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated discount rates reducing equity valuation multiples, as evidenced by historical monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% each over the past month indicate broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS by >1% each in the prior month does not lead to negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.5% in one month signals supply chain disruption, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced manufacturing output and earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated CPI index (CPIAUCSL) above 310 signals persistent inflation, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 310.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% each over the past month indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS by >1% each in the prior month does not lead to positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects stronger economic activity, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
